contains: Full voiceover, 0:00 to the end. If absent the video renders silent on the script.json timings.
Screen recording: the visualizer replaying the reconstruction with Safety OFF. Both clearances are issued and nothing stops them. 10 s, 16:9.
Screen recording: the same calls with Safety ON. The stop appears and is routed to the owning controller. 16 s, 16:9.
The synthetic stop call Hold Short speaks on the radio, about 1.5 s.
Screen recording: an agent attempts a forbidden write and the security_events row that results. 4 s, 16:9.
Screen recording: a controller switches an agent off and its next intent is refused. 5 s, 16:9.
Screen recording: the visualizer timeline scrubbed back through the event (time travel). 5 s, 16:9.
Team photo or four avatars (real photos only, no generated faces). Optional.
